assets.name: maternal-care
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: NGO public-health website educational illustration about Sierra Leone.
Style/medium: Premium hand-painted editorial gouache illustration on textured warm paper. Visibly a crafted illustration with expressive brush edges, matte pigment layering, natural human proportions, dignified people and warm natural African skin tones. Consistent palette of rich navy, forest green, teal, restrained gold and warm cream.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 composition, balanced scene with clear human interaction, enough surrounding environment to establish context, polished contemporary editorial artwork.
Lighting/mood: Warm daylight, welcoming, trustworthy, calm, respectful.
Constraints: Original invented people, no real named people or organisations. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, flags, official seals or legible data. Do not simulate documentary photography. No injection, needles, clinical procedures or distress.
Primary request: A Sierra Leonean mother seated comfortably holding her swaddled newborn, speaking with a female African health worker in a welcoming modest clinic. The worker is listening attentively at eye level. Their expressions are relaxed and reassuring. Simple airy clinic with a bench, pale wall, window and leafy greenery; no medical procedure.
